record.question: The first country in Asia to legalise same sex marriage is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Taiwan. Taiwan was the first place in Asia to enact a law permitting same-sex marriage in 2019. Reference: https://www.loc.gov/item/global-legal-monitor/2019-06-18/taiwan-same-sex-marriage-law-enters-into-effect/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
